verdict.rationale: Brex documents registrable outbound webhooks. Developers register an endpoint URL via the webhooks API to receive selected events, such as pending card transactions and referral activations. Signing secrets are provided to validate deliveries. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery, and a full documented catalog of event types in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Register an endpoint to start receiving selected webhook events
Brex APIs offer webhooks to notify you in real-time when certain events happen in your account.
Subscribe to receive pending transaction events for expenses made on Brex Card
This endpoint returns a set of webhook signing secrets used to validate the webhook.
Register a URL to receive the webhooks using the [register webhook] endpoint.
